description: A run of consecutive tool calls collapsed into one summary line — "3 tools · 1 failed · 4.2 s" — whose disclosure renders one TmToolCallCard per call. The counts are localized through plural families, so Czech reads "3 nástroje · 1 selhal" and the duration uses the localizer's decimal separator ("4,2 s"). The total duration is shown only once every call of the run has finished: a total that is still growing is not a duration, and the running card carries its own live elapsed time. TmAiMessage groups a run of two or more consecutive tool-call parts and renders a single call as its own card.

examples.title: Collapse an agent loop into one line
Start expanded and let the host retry a failed call of the run

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: DefaultExpanded
parameters.description: Whether the run starts expanded. Default false: a long agent loop stays one tidy line.

parameters.name: OnRetry
parameters.description: Raised with the call that failed when the reader asks to run it again; forwarded to every card in the run. The cards' Retry buttons render only when a handler is bound.

parameters.name: ToolCalls
parameters.description: The calls of one run, in arrival order. An empty or null list renders nothing, so a host can bind a filtered list without branching.
